LA VERNE YOUTH & FAMILY ACTION COMMITTEE
  Minutes of the Regular Meeting
  April 22, 2025

1. A meeting of the Youth & Family Action Committee was called to order by Council
  Member Rick Crosby at 5:05 p.m.

  Executive Board Members present:

  Executive Board
  Rick Crosby, Council Member
  Wendy Lau, Council Member
  Brittany Allison, BUSD Board Member
  Denise Fisher, Resident
  Don Kendrick, Resident

2. Review of Minutes  Minutes for the March 25, 2025, meeting were approved
  unanimously.

3. SRO Report  School Resource Officer Eduardo Burgos shared that he
  was in preparations for graduation in early June for Bonita
  High School. He shared about the Student Government
  Day at City Hall with Grace Miller. Assistant City Manager
  JR Ranells shared more details about the Student
  Government Day program with the committee.

4. CRR Specialist Report  Community Risk Reduction Specialist Lonnie Shipman
  shared about his recent attendance at the Career Day
  event hosted by David & Margaret Youth and Family
  Services. The City sent representatives from the Police
  Department, Fire Department, Human Resources and
  Community Services.

5. BUSD Report  BUSD Representative Steven Patterson shared that the
  district is in a particularly busy season. There was a
  successful event with the Dust Buddies Prom for students
  with special needs. He also shared that attendance is still
  going strong and that the district is seeing a wide increase
  in TK enrollment.

6. BUSD Student Update  The BUSD Student Liaisons shared that the district was
  working through State Testing and AP testing. The Spring
  musical is coming up as well as the Pop Show and Jazz
  under the stars. Liaison Lauren also shared about her
  recent trip and what she learned after receiving the Rotary
  Youth Leadership Award.
 Youth & Family Action Committee Minutes February 25, 2025, page 2

7. Utility Box Art Project  Senior Management Analyst Erin Beilstein shared an
  update with the group regarding the Utility Box Art Project
  and shared the submissions with the group. A YFAC
  subcommittee will be formed to work together to
  determine next steps with the project. The subcommittee
  will bring it back to the group at the next YFAC meeting.

8. Tri-City Mental Health  Representatives from Tri-City Mental Health attended
  YFAC and shared with the group about the Community
  Navigator program and information about the Mental
  Health services offered by the organization. They shared
  about the summer camp coming up at the Wellness
  Center as well as the free support groups available to the
  community. Tri-City Mental Health is focused on
  connecting people with the right services even if it is a
  service they do not offer, they will find the right person to
  connect with.

9. Parks Master Plan  Senior Management Analyst Nicole Houston and the
  Parks Master Plan team shared about the current process
  of the City’s Parks Master Plan project. They presented
  on what has been done so far, what the project is looking
  to do, and how the committee and community could
  provide input. They asked for stakeholder input as the
  plan moves forward.

10. City Committees, Commissions, and Boards

  Council Member Crosby shared with the committee some
  background on City Council’s effort to revamp the
  Committees, Commissions, and Boards for the City. City
  Manger Ken Domer reviewed the process that has
  happened to date and shared with the committee about
  the project. Focused on the unification of process when it
  comes to how the committees are organized, how
  representatives are chosen, and how the groups are
  governed, the City Council is moving forward with a
  Second Reading of the Ordinance at the next Council
  Meeting. Additionally, City Manager Domer mentioned
  that there could be an interest in creating a Community
  Foundation which could act as a fundraising arm for the
  community for things such as the Fourth of July and
  Christmas Morning events and more.

11. Public Comment
 Youth & Family Action Committee Minutes February 25, 2025, page 3

11. Next Meeting  The next YFAC meeting was scheduled for June 24, 2025
  at 5:00pm.

12. Adjournment  The meeting was adjourned at 6:07 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

Erin Beilstein
Senior Management Analyst
